ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by test agent. _CHUNK_ALIAS_RE in /app/backend/bifrost.py only matched '\.nc\d+\.js$' but forward rewrite (CHUNK_VER='camo1') emits '.camo1.js'. Result: 7+ Next.js chunk requests under /api/bifrost/v1/app/_next/static/chunks/*.camo1.js returned 404 and /app was stuck on 'Getting ready / Warming up proofs' splash forever. Fix: widened regex to '\.(?:nc|camo)\d+\.js$'. After fix all chunks 200, wallet UI boots, wallet creation works, key prefixes verified.

issues: CAMO particle text is monochrome white (good), but the progress bar (.vl-bar > i) uses a purple→cyan gradient and the subtext 'Warming up proofs' / 'Loading your notes' renders in purple. Task required 'CAMO monochrome particle splash (no purple/green)'. Suggest switching the bar fill and subtext color to the Gloam ink/mute tokens (#08090c / #4b5563) to match the rest of the rebrand.

HTML on /app still contains ~33 raw 'veil' occurrences in CSS custom-property NAMES (--veil-fg, --veil-hi, --veil-deep, --veil-wash) and link-match selectors (a[href*='github.com/veil'], a[href*='@veilit.xyz']). Not user-visible text, but a brand leak in dev-tools / View Source. Consider renaming CSS vars to --cm-* / --camo-* in /app/backend/brand/nc-theme.css and dk-swap.js.

action_items: Confirm the one-line fix in /app/backend/bifrost.py (line 373): _CHUNK_ALIAS_RE now '\.(?:nc|camo)\d+\.js$'. Previously only 'nc' prefix was accepted, so any CHUNK_VER bump beyond 'nc*' would break /app silently. Keep both prefixes to retain backwards-compat with cached HTML.
Repaint the /app boot splash to monochrome: replace the purple→cyan .vl-bar gradient and purple subtext color with the Gloam ink/mute palette so the splash matches the landing rebrand.

Rename --veil-* CSS variables and the a[href*='veil']/[href*='veilit.xyz'] selectors in /app/backend/brand/nc-theme.css and dk-swap.js to --camo-*/[href*='camo'] to eliminate the ~33 raw 'veil' tokens still present in /app HTML.
Optional: expose the camovk1 viewing key somewhere in the UI (Settings → Keys / Backup) so users can verify / export it. Currently create-wallet only reveals the camosk2 recovery key.
critical_code_review_comments: bifrost.py: forward chunk rewrite (CHUNK_VER) and reverse alias (_CHUNK_ALIAS_RE) are decoupled constants — any future bump of CHUNK_VER will silently 404 all chunks unless the reverse regex is updated. Consider deriving the regex from CHUNK_VER directly (e.g. re.compile(rf'\.{re.escape(CHUNK_VER)}\.js$|\.nc\d+\.js$')) so they can never drift again.
/app/backend/brand/dk-swap.js is still ~1100 lines (carried over from iter 12/31) — remains the single biggest file in the brand overlay and would benefit from a split.

test_live_endpoints.py and test_iter27_live_brand.py still require REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported in the shell before pytest; they don't auto-load /app/frontend/.env. Non-blocking but worth adding python-dotenv load.

rca of the issue: RCA for /app blank-splash bug: bifrost.py introduced CHUNK_VER='camo1' and rewrites outgoing HTML/JS chunk refs via _CHUNK_REF_RE to '*.camo1.js'. On the inbound side the proxy strips the version suffix before fetching upstream using _CHUNK_ALIAS_RE, but that regex was still hardcoded to '\.nc\d+\.js$' from the previous 'nc1' versioning scheme. Mismatch → every chunk request 404 → Next.js hydration never starts → UI frozen on vl-* splash. Reproduction: GET /api/bifrost/v1/app/_next/static/chunks/<hash>.camo1.js returns 404. Fix: changed line 373 to _CHUNK_ALIAS_RE = re.compile(r'\.(?:nc|camo)\d+\.js$'). After supervisorctl restart backend, the same URL returns 200 and the wallet UI boots end-to-end.
